options.content: ## Django | Language | Framework | Runtime | Concurrency model | Host port | |---|---|---|---|---| | Python | Django 6.1 on gunicorn 26 | CPython 3.14 | Synchronous WSGI; WORKERS gunicorn processes, one request at a time each | `3109` | [Source](https://github.com/rshdhere/load-test/tree/main/servers/django) · [Dockerfile](https://github.com/rshdhere/load-test/blob/main/servers/django/Dockerfile) · Load-test it from a shell: `SERVER=django npm run break:grafana` in `bench/k6` ### ▶ Run a load test on Django · ⚔ Race it against others

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Result of the most recent /api/v1/health check.

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Share of passing health checks over the time range, while monitoring was running.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Time for the latest health check to complete.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the container last started.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU in use right now, as a share of one core.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working-set memory right now.

panels.title: Reliability · objective: 99.9% of health checks pass over 30 days
30-day availability
panels.description: Share of passing health checks over the last 30 days.

panels.title: Error budget left
panels.description: Share of the 30-day error budget (0.1% of checks may fail) not yet spent. Below zero means the objective is missed.

panels.title: Burn rate (1h)
panels.description: How fast the budget is being spent over the last hour: 1x would use exactly the whole budget in 30 days. At 14.4x, a single hour spends 2% of it, which raises an alert.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Times the container restarted after exiting, within the time range.

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Processes the kernel killed for running out of memory, within the time range.

panels.title: Error budget burn rate
panels.description: Budget spend relative to sustainable, over 1-hour and 6-hour windows. Dashed lines mark the 6x and 14.4x alerting levels.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing or pending for Django right now. Empty is good.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU as a share of one core (200% = 2 cores). Single-threaded runtimes cap out near 100%.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set (what the kernel counts against limits) and RSS.

panels.title: Threads and processes
panels.description: OS threads and processes inside the container.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bytes per second received (above the axis) and sent (below).

panels.title: Health check latency
panels.description: Duration of each health check, split by phase.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests sent to this server by the selected runs.

panels.title: Peak req/s
panels.description: Highest sustained request rate.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Failed requests as a share of all requests.

targets.expr: (sum by (testid) (max_over_time(k6_http_reqs_total{testid=~"$testid",server=~"$server",group!~"::setup|::teardown",expected_response="false"}[$__range])) or sum by (testid) (max_over_time(k6_http_reqs_total{testid=~"$testid",server=~"$server",group!~"::setup|::teardown"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (testid) (max_over_time(k6_http_reqs_total{testid=~"$testid",server=~"$server",group!~"::setup|::teardown"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Typical p99
panels.description: Median over the run of each 1s window's p99 latency.

panels.title: Throughput vs virtual users
panels.description: Request rate (left) against active VUs (right).

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Per-window request duration.

panels.title: Container CPU during tests
panels.description: This server's CPU while k6 was running, to show how close it got to its core limit.

panels.title: Inside the server · every request, seen through eBPF
Requests/s
panels.description: Requests the server is answering right now, counted by Beyla from inside the kernel: load tests, health checks and anything else.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Share of requests in the time range the server answered with a 5xx.

panels.title: Server p50
panels.description: Median time from the request reaching the server to the response leaving it, over the time range.

panels.title: Server p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of the same, over the time range.

panels.title: Requests by status code
panels.description: Responses per second, by HTTP status, as the server sent them.

panels.title: Inside the server vs at the client
panels.description: Server-side p50 and p99 (Beyla) against the p99 k6 measured (dashed). The gap is time spent in the network, kernel queues and k6 itself, not in the server's code.

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Everything the Django container writes, shipped to Loki by Alloy.

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: A 5% sample of requests, traced by Beyla through eBPF. Click a trace ID to see where the time went.
